title: Occasions and Figures
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 22 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Pieces made for a moment. The works in this room were drawn for occasions: the hundredth, two hundredth, three hundredth and five hundredth inks, a summer, a pizza day, a greeting. With them hang the few full figures and painted scenes from outside the named series. Twenty-two works, from October 2021 to December 2024.

Most of them carry words. NIFTY INK on a tee shirt, WAGMI on a bottle, a number held up like a sign, slogans written across a face. The words are drawn, not typed, and they sit in the picture like any other mark.
Watch the sun-head. It appears in May 2022 as a figure with a sun for a face, in a tee shirt, on a beach, in the dark, dancing. Two years later it comes back as a pizza.

chapters.title: The First Day and a Dragon
chapters.opening: October 20, 2021, the first day of nnxyz on Nifty Ink: a figure in a cap and a river landscape. Then, in December, a dragon on the water.

works.title: nnxyz randoomdle with cap
works.text: A figure in a blue cap and a yellow shirt, drawn in orange and white hatching with the letters N N X Y Z written in pink across its face, grinning with white teeth. The ground is a dense weave of red, green and blue hatching. The first nnxyz work on Nifty Ink, drawn October 20, 2021, and the name is already on the face.
works.caption: A figure in a blue cap and yellow shirt, the letters NNXYZ written in pink across its grinning face.
works.reading: The cap is drawn in blue with white highlights. The letters sit over the eyes and nose, N and N above, X Y Z below. The shirt is yellow with orange shading and a few red marks. The signature and the year are drawn at the upper left. Recorded with 350 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz good morning nifty randoomdle
works.text: A river runs through a green valley under a sky of pink and white cloud, with a tree at the left and a stump at the right, all painted in soft strokes and scribble. Drawn six hours after the figure in the cap, on the same first day. It is a landscape without a face in it, and with 737 recorded strokes one of the most worked drawings in the wing.
works.caption: A river through a green valley under pink cloud, a tree at the left, a stump at the right.
works.reading: The water is painted in horizontal strokes of blue and lilac with white scribble over it. The hills are green with darker scribble. The tree at the left has a round crown drawn in loops. The clouds are pink and white discs on blue.

works.title: nnxyz Smaug on the Water
works.text: A dragon rises from blue water, its head at the right, its body a long curve of gold and white strokes, its tail trailing across the dark sky. The water is a mass of cyan and white scribble like foam. The sky is black. With 270,739 recorded points it is the most densely drawn work in the whole collection, and the only dragon.
works.caption: A dragon of gold and white strokes rises from a mass of cyan and white foam under a black sky.
works.reading: The head is drawn in white, gold and blue strokes with a long jaw and spikes. The body curves up and back into the sky as a ribbon of pale strokes. The foam is drawn in tight white loops over blue. Recorded on December 7, 2021, with 638 strokes.

chapters.title: Hundreds and Summers
chapters.opening: January to November 2022. Four milestone drawings for the hundredth, two hundredth, three hundredth and five hundredth inks, and three summer figures with a sun for a head.

works.title: nnxyz 100 nifties
works.text: Three cartoon characters in green, blue and pink stand in a row with the letters X, Y and Z on their chests and the number 100 drawn above them in pale balloon letters. Their eyes are wide, their mouths open, and they drip at the feet into a grey floor. The milestone for the hundredth ink, made January 28, 2022.
works.caption: Three cartoon characters in green, blue and pink with X, Y and Z on their chests, 100 drawn above them.
works.reading: Each character has a round head with two eyes, a V brow and an O mouth, and a crown of short strokes. The green one is widest-eyed. The drips at their feet are the same colors as their bodies, and the floor reflects them. Recorded with 324 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz 200 nifties
works.text: Figures glow in a burst of light, drawn in gold and grey with a hand raised, and the words 200 NIFTY INK at the upper left.
works.caption: Figures glow in a burst of light in gold and grey, 200 NIFTY INK written at the upper left.
works.reading: The light comes from a white disc at the center and spreads in rays. The figures are drawn in soft grey and gold, three heads at the top and a crowd below. The lettering is white, drawn in loose capitals. Recorded with 651 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty summer ink
works.text: A figure with a sun for a head stands on blue in a white tee that says NIFTY INK, black shorts and sunglasses with X Y Z on the lenses, holding a bottle labeled WAGMI with bubbles rising from it. The sun is yellow with short rays. The arms and legs are yellow lines. The first of three summer figures, drawn May 10, 2022.
works.caption: A sun-headed figure on blue in a NIFTY INK tee and sunglasses holds a bottle labeled WAGMI.
works.reading: The sunglasses are black with the letters drawn in white. The tee is white with black and blue lettering in a box. The bottle is drawn in black line with bubbles rising to the upper right. The yellow legs end in a few strokes for feet. Recorded with 220 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty summer night ink
works.text: The same sun-headed figure at night, glowing in a ring of yellow on black, its tee grey, its arms out.
works.caption: A sun-headed figure glows in a ring of yellow on black, its NIFTY INK tee grey in the dark.
works.reading: The glow is a soft ring of yellow and olive around the head, and the head itself is a yellow disc with three dots for a face. The tee and shorts are drawn in white and grey line. Ninety-seven strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nifty summer dance ink
works.text: The sun-headed figure dances on teal in headphones, one leg kicked out, the word WAGMI floating around it with music notes and wavy lines.
works.caption: A sun-headed figure dances on teal in headphones, one leg kicked out, WAGMI floating around it.
works.reading: The headphones are black over the sun. The legs are yellow lines bent in a kick. The word WAGMI is written three times in orange. Yellow zigzags stand up from the ground. Recorded with 202 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz 300 nifties
works.text: A figure in black and white line with a visor and a grin holds a line that runs up to the signature, and a small figure at its feet holds up a sign that says 300.
works.caption: A black and white figure with a visor and a grin, a small figure holding a sign reading 300.
works.reading: The large figure is drawn in black scribble with a grey shadow behind it. The visor is a box with two slits. The small figure is drawn in thin line with the sign in red. Ninety-nine strokes.

works.title: nnxyz 500 inks
works.text: A face in dense colored line on orange: a long nose, two glasses-like rings, dark hair falling at the sides, a small closed mouth, drawn in black, yellow, blue, white and red strokes over a painted face. It is the milestone for the five hundredth ink, drawn November 12, 2022, and it is a portrait, not a cartoon.
works.caption: A face in dense colored line on orange, long nose, ringed eyes, dark hair falling at the sides.
works.reading: The face is painted in soft orange and gold under the line. The eyes are drawn as rings with small pupils. The hair is black strokes at both sides. A red bar crosses the eyes. Recorded with 261 strokes.

chapters.title: Figures of 2023 and 2024
chapters.opening: Six numbered works from November 2023 to March 2024 that are figures, not masks: a dancing girl, a rabbit, a hooded figure, a crouching creature, a pair, and a creature with hearts.

works.title: nnxyz #8
works.text: A girl with orange curly hair and pink cheeks dances in a teal frame, her arms drawn in blue loops, a shower of yellow and blue dots falling at the left.
works.caption: A girl with orange curly hair dances in a teal frame, arms in blue loops, dots falling at the left.
works.reading: The hair is a mass of orange loops with a red knot on top. The arms and body are drawn in blue and white loops like coils. The legs are orange with stripes. The frame is a lighter teal band. Recorded with 146 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #12
works.text: On pink, a black figure walks at the left, a red rabbit stands at the center with ringed eyes, and a dark figure with a white smile stands at the right under a yellow sun with a face. Yellow bars float behind them. The three figures are drawn in different ways, the first in black with a yellow face, the rabbit in red scribble, the third in black with a tangle of yellow line. It is the one crowd scene in the room.
works.caption: On pink, a black walking figure, a red rabbit with ringed eyes, and a dark smiling figure under a sun.
works.reading: The sun at the upper left is a yellow disc with two eyes and a mouth, and its rays are yellow lines. The rabbit's ears are two tall red shapes. The yellow bars behind are drawn in loose rectangles like bricks. Recorded with 140 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #18
works.text: A hooded figure painted in dark brown against orange and gold, its face lost in the hood, thin lines ruled across the whole square.
works.caption: Dark brown paint makes a hooded figure against orange and gold, thin lines ruled across it.
works.reading: The hood is painted in brown with a lighter edge. The ground is soft orange with grey and gold strokes. The ruled lines are thin and horizontal. The figure's shoulders are drawn in black scribble. Recorded with 263 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #26
works.text: A black creature with a crown of spikes and a grin of teeth crouches on yellow, drawn in black and blue scribble, hatched lines at the right.
works.caption: A black creature with a crown of spikes and a grin crouches on yellow in black and blue scribble.
works.reading: The creature is a black mass with a white edge, its head turned to show an eye and a mouth of teeth. Blue line loops around it. The hatching at the right is black diagonal lines. Seventy-five strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #34
works.text: Two figures on teal, one in a cap and one with red X eyes and a red beam, drawn in dark scribble with white line over them.
works.caption: Two figures on teal, one in a cap, one with red X eyes and a red beam, in dark scribble.
works.reading: The figure at the left wears a cap drawn in yellow and purple. The one at the right has two red X marks and a beam running to the right edge. Yellow lights hang in a string above. Recorded with 297 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #35
works.text: A green and red creature in sunglasses with a mouth of teeth stands on purple, with three red hearts beside it, each with a small face, and a dark figure in a cap on a pole at the right. A sad sun looks down from the top. Blue raindrops fall. The hearts have faces, the sun has a face, and the creature has sunglasses: everything in the picture looks at something.
works.caption: A green and red creature in sunglasses on purple, three red hearts with faces beside it, a sad sun above.
works.reading: The creature is striped in green and red with a crest of purple spikes. The hearts are red with white eyes and mouths. The figure on the pole wears a cap and a collar. The sun is a yellow disc with a frown. Recorded with 208 strokes.

chapters.title: Pizza Day and After
chapters.opening: May to December 2024. Three pizza drawings in two days, a pink head, and two masks covered in words.

works.title: pizza pizza day
works.text: A pizza slice for a head, with red glasses and a grin, under a yellow sun with a face, drawn in orange and gold hatching with yellow rays over everything. Two years after the sun-headed summer figures, the sun is back, and the figure under it has become a slice of pizza. The first of three pizza drawings, made May 19, 2024.
works.caption: A pizza slice for a head, red glasses and a grin, under a yellow sun with a face.
works.reading: The slice is drawn as a triangle with red circles for pepperoni and a crust at the edge. The glasses are red frames with white lenses. The sun at the upper left has two eyes and a mouth. The rays are long yellow strokes. Recorded with 250 strokes.

works.title: pizza pizza pizza day
works.text: A round head on black with pizza slices on top like a crown, blue glasses, a grin of white teeth, and a slice of pizza on its white shirt.
works.caption: A round head on black crowned with pizza slices, blue glasses, a grin, pizza on its shirt.
works.reading: The glasses are blue boxes with crossed marks inside. The teeth are a wide row of white blocks. The slices on top are drawn in orange and red with rays. The arms are raised at both sides. Recorded with 218 strokes.

works.title: pizza pizza pizza pizza day
works.text: A man in red glasses and a red cape stands in blue rain holding up a sign with hearts, a pizza flying at the upper right and a small creature at his feet.
works.caption: A caped man in red glasses holds up a sign with hearts in blue rain, pizza flying.
works.reading: The man is drawn in dark scribble with spiky hair and a grin. The cape is red with yellow line. The sign is a white box on a stick with red hearts. The creature at the lower right is orange with its own red glasses. Recorded with 553 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz abi ninja
works.caption: A dense scribbled head on pink with a red target eye, ABI NINJA written below.
works.reading: The head is drawn in black and colored scribble with a crest of spikes. The target eye is red and white. The arms are black shapes raised at the sides. The letters are white, drawn at the bottom. Sixty-nine strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #64
works.text: A face inside a black frame, covered in words: DIGITAL ART in pink, BLUE CHIP in blue, OG, and a line about going from dishwasher to memewasher along the top. The face has a red crossed eye, a grin of white teeth and a yellow hook of a nose. Green and blue scribble fills the rest. The words are drawn in as many hands as colors.
works.caption: A face in a black frame covered in words, DIGITAL ART in pink, one eye crossed in red.
works.reading: The frame is a thick black border. The crossed eye is a red X in a ring at the center. The teeth are white bars in a black mouth. The words run along the top, down the right side and across the bottom. Recorded with 432 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz #66
works.text: A mask with a pink flower for an eye and a grin of teeth, under the words NO NEED FOR A WALL in yellow and black, with memewasher, artfluencer and sold by Christies written around it in white, pink and red. Drawn the day after the framed face, December 5, 2024. It is the last work in the collection by date, and it is mostly writing.
works.caption: A mask with a pink flower for an eye under the words NO NEED FOR A WALL.
works.reading: The flower eye is a pink bloom with a white center in a ring. The mouth is a red box of white teeth. The ground is tan with grey strokes and ruled lines. The lettering at the top is yellow with a black shadow. Recorded with 358 strokes.

relatedItems.title: GM
relatedItems.text: A related item from the Scrimshaw collection: the letters G and M drawn in looping colored line on a muddy ground, a greeting by the artist Scrimshaw, dated November 2021. It hangs here with the occasion pieces because it is one.
relatedItems.caption: The letters G and M drawn in looping colored line on a muddy ground, a greeting by Scrimshaw.
relatedItems.reading: The G is at the left and the M at the right, each drawn several times over in different colors. The ground is brown and grey scribble. It is the only text piece in the Scrimshaw collection, and it is shown here as a related item.
relatedItems.note: Related item shown after the room. Counted in Scrimshaw, not in this room.

closing: Look again at the first figure, with the artist's name written across its face in October 2021, and then at the last, a mask under a slogan in December 2024. Three years apart, and both are faces made partly of words.
